hed: UKMTO: vessel struck by unknown projectile in Hormuz; Iran reports Qeshm hit with 1 dead
dek: UK Maritime Trade Operations said it received a report about 2300 GMT Saturday that a vessel transiting the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unknown projectile; a Sunday update said a fire broke out and local authorities were helping evacuate the crew. Separately, Iranian state media said an Iranian commercial vessel was struck near Qeshm Island, killing one person and injuring others, according to CNN citing IRIB and IRNA. Named outlets have not confirmed the UKMTO alert and the Iranian casualty claim describe the same ship.

cl.body: CNBC, Anadolu Agency, and CNN lead with UKMTO’s Saturday ~2300 GMT report of an unknown projectile strike in Hormuz, Sunday’s fire-and-evacuation update, and Iran’s separate Qeshm claim of one dead and injuries — without treating the two accounts as a confirmed single vessel pending independent matching.

cr.body: Anadolu’s UKMTO updates and CNN’s Hormuz desk pair the British maritime alert with Iran’s Qeshm casualty report and Oman shipping talks context — reading Sunday’s dual track as another contested chokepoint incident while noting outlets have not publicly confirmed the UKMTO vessel and the Iranian ship are the same.

stack_blurb: UKMTO: Hormuz projectile strike + fire/evac; Iran Qeshm claim: 1 dead.
seo_description: UKMTO reported a vessel struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz with Sunday fire and crew evacuation; Iran separately reported a Qeshm commercial vessel hit with one dead.
